At its core, IFA is committed to creating and nurturing spaces where Indigenous knowledge, languages, and traditions are celebrated and interwoven with modern technological advancements. Deliver technical solutions related to electrical and power distribution products for infrastructure projects, including data centers and other large-scale facilities. Lead specification integration by coordinating with various stakeholders, clarifying technical requirements, and ensuring alignment between internal teams, external suppliers, and on-site installation partners. Act as a key point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders. Internal stakeholders include overseas manufacturing and engineering teams, while external stakeholders include construction-related partners and subcontractors involved in project execution. Work primarily on large-scale projects, which account for the majority of the portfolio, alongside involvement in renewable energy–related projects as part of a diversified project mix. Qualifications for the role Minimum of a technical college degree (engineering-related) Over 10 years of experience in the same industry (power distribution equipment industry) Experience as a team leader 【Japanese】JLPT N1 level or above in Japanese language 【English】 reading and writing level (TOEIC score 600 or higher). A mindset to innovate, take ownership, and drive continuous improvement Key Attractions and Features of This Role As demand in Japan continues to grow for products aligned with Western, globally driven standards, our company conducts product development under the strong leadership of our global headquarters. By being involved in a rapidly growing business, you will have the opportunity to build a broad and flexible foundation for long-term career development. By collaborating with global technology leaders that continuously drive innovation, you will gain exposure to a wide range of cutting-edge insights. In addition, working with a diverse group of stakeholders will enable you to develop highly transferable communication skills and effectively operate in a complex, global environment. Products Medium-Voltage Products: Modular systems, switchgear, components, protection relays, and related services https://new.abb.com/low-voltage/ja Low-Voltage Products: Power distribution equipment, control devices, electrical installation materials, and energy management and protection solutions https://new.abb.com/medium-voltage/ja More about us ABB is a technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable and resource-efficient future. The company’s solutions connect engineering know-how and software to optimize how things are manufactured, moved, powered, and operated. Building on over 140 years of excellence, ABB’s more than 105,000 employees are committed to driving innovations that accelerate industrial transformation. www.abb.com ABB in Japan The roots of the group go back to 1907 when its predecessor opened the first office in Yokohama. Today, we operate with about 400 employees and offer our unique products, systems, solutions and services to local customers with our expertise.
